title: Attorney merely copied on a business email
constitution: §24 privilege is high-risk; §44 privilege cc → no automatic privilege; §22 sensitivity gates on export
expected: A document with counsel on cc but no privilege coding is 'normal' sensitivity; a document coded privileged is hidden from a paralegal export and from a litigation-support production, and only exportable by an attorney under the log-export obligation.
passCriteria: partitionByPolicy(paralegal, export, [cc, privileged]).allowed is empty (paralegals do not export)
partitionByPolicy(litigation_support, export, [cc, privileged]).allowed === [cc] and denied reason mentions privileged
partitionByPolicy(associate, export, ...).allowed has both with obligation log-export
